# Graphify — LeeWay Execution Adapter

Canonical URL supplied by the Creator: `https://github.com/safishamsi/graphify`.

The current GitHub connector observes a repository redirect at that URL, so resolve the live canonical target before any installation or source pinning. Do not silently substitute a fork.

## Route here when

- a codebase/project should be mapped into a persistent queryable knowledge graph;
- the task spans code plus documentation, schemas, infrastructure, papers, images, or video;
- deterministic structural extraction and explicit relationship provenance are useful;
- repeated raw-file reading/search debt should be reduced.

When Graphify is actually available, verify its CLI/runtime, target directory, output location, and exit status. Preserve the distinction between relationships extracted directly from source and relationships inferred by the tool/model.

Do not claim `graph.html`, `graph.json`, `GRAPH_REPORT.md`, call-flow exports, token savings, or any graph result exists unless the runtime generated and verified it.

State until canonical redirect + runtime are verified: `REMOTE_REDIRECT_ADAPTER`.
